title: ETHInferenceNetwork
tagline: A P2P network for AI inference with a free market for prices and per-request payments
description:
#Where Intelligence Meets Instant Payments


##A P2P (peer-to-peer) network for AI inference creates a free and open market to solve these problems. It connects two types of participants:


 For Consumers,  Developers, end-users, or even other AI agents can access a wide range of models. Instead of a subscription or a fixed-price plan, they pay for each request, ensuring they only spend what they use.

The Problem

Today's AI is dominated by centralized APIs, leading to fixed, high costs, and a single point of failure for censorship and geographic restrictions. Meanwhile, vast amounts of GPU power sit idle, a global resource that is not being utilized.

The Solution

ETH Inference Network is a permissionless, peer-to-peer marketplace that connects those with idle GPU power to developers and AI agents in need of computing resources. Using our network, you can access a free market for AI models, where prices are set by competition, not by a corporation.

The Technology

We’ve built ETH Inference Network on the Base blockchain and leverage CDP Wallets and the x402 protocol to enable instant, per-request micropayments directly between users and providers. This allows us to create a truly trustless, pay-as-you-go system.

Why It Matters

ETH Inference Network isn't just an app; it's a foundational layer for a new AI economy. We are building the tools to enable a future where AI is accessible, censorship-resistant, and its value is shared across a decentralized network. We are building a system of interconnected, autonomous AI agents that can buy and sell intelligence on their own, proving our alignment with the Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) Alliance's vision of a decentralized, agent-driven ecosystem.

## Technical Architecture

### Frontend
- *Next.js 15* React application with TypeScript
- *Tailwind CSS* for styling with custom animations
- *Radix UI* components for accessible interface
- *Dark mode* optimized design

### API Infrastructure
- *OpenRouter Integration*: Proxy to various AI model providers
- *ASI (Artificial Superintelligence Alliance)* endpoints
- *Walrus Network* integration
- Dynamic routing for multiple providers and models

### Key Dependencies
- @coinbase/x402 - Payment protocol implementation
- x402-next - Next.js specific X402 integration
- Multiple Radix UI components for interface
- Comprehensive TypeScript support
